Name: BetterBombs
Author: Duno666
Description:
BetterBombs increases the utility of bombs by offering several configurable options to change bomb behavior.

The mod creates a `config.json` file in its mod folder the first time you run it. You can open that file in a text editor to configure the mod or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].

These are the available settings:

BreakClumps: Bombs will break resource clumps - Acts as a master switch, types of clumps need to be enabled individually. (Default: False)
BreakStoneClumps: Bombs will break boulders and custom stone-based clumps (Default: False)
BreakWoodClumps: Bombs will break stumps, logs, etc. (Default: False)
BreakWeedsClumps: Bombs will break the large grass clumps that occur during green rain. (Default: False)
BreakOtherClumps: Bombs will break miscellaneous resource clumps that are added by mods. There are no vanilla clumps in this category. (Default: False)
CollectMinerals: Bombs will collect grabbable minerals on the ground instead of destroying them. (Default: False)
CollectForage: Bombs will collect grabbable forage on the ground instead of destroying them. The same formula as vanilla is used to determine quality. (Default: False)
CollectFish: Bombs will collect grabbable shells and fish on the ground instead of destroying them. Uses the same formula as forage to determine quality level. (Default: False)
CollectedQuality: Collected forage and fish will have a quality level appropriate to your foraging level and professions. (Default: True)
CollectedDegrade: Reduces the quality level of forage collected via explosives by one. Iridium -> Gold, Gold -> Silver, Silver -> Regular. No effect if CollectedQuality is disabled. (Default: False)
DamageFarmers: Bombs will deal damage to players. Only controls damage for explosions that would have damaged the farmer. (Default: False)
Radius: A multiplier to the default radius of bombs. (Default: 1.0) [url=https://github.com/PhillZitt/BetterBombs/issues/6]Beware of values above 3
[/url]Damage: A multiplier to the default damage of bombs. (Default: 1.0)
TillDirt: A toggle for whether explosions will till soil like a hoe. (Default: True)
FlashScreen: Toggles whether the screen flashes when an explosion occurs. (Default: True)

[url=https://github.com/PhillZitt/BetterBombs/issues]Please report all bugs and feature requests on GitHub.[/url]﻿

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2488]Useful Bombs by punyo[/url].
